rot.ideia.ex1.e1: You are Black. White moved the f- and g-pawns: the king's shield is gone.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Look at the diagonal from h4 to e1: there is no piece in the way.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Your queen can get there. Look for the check that nobody can block.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Give checkmate with the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Checkmate: it is the fool's mate, the fastest in chess.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The queen goes to h4 and checks along the diagonal. Nothing can block and the king has no square.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d8g5.1: The queen attacks the pawn on g4, but gives no check.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d8g5.2: Let's go back: look for the check along the open diagonal.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not mate. Let's go back: look at the diagonal to e1.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Give checkmate with the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The white king has no square: d1, d2, e2 and f1 are taken by its own pieces.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: And the f2 square is empty, but the queen attacks it.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Remember the idea: without the f- and g-pawns, the king's diagonal is open.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: One move earlier. White moved the f-pawn: the diagonal from h4 to e1 is now open.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Your queen is still stuck behind the pawn on e7. Open her path.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Open the queen's path to h4, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The pawn steps aside and the queen already sees h4.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The king's pawn advances: the queen's diagonal to h4 becomes free.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.e7e6.1: That works too! The queen already sees h4.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.e7e6.2: Look also at the pawn two squares ahead, which also takes the center.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d7d5.1: The pawn opens another path, but the queen still does not see h4.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d7d5.2: Let's go back: the pawn blocking the queen's diagonal is the one on e7.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not open the path to h4. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Open the queen's path to h4, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: White errs again: the g-pawn moves too.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now nothing blocks the diagonal to e1. The mate is ready.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Remember the idea: open the queen's path and wait for the second mistake.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: Now I will show the whole fool's mate and what happens with only one mistake.
rot.demos.louco.e1: The fool's mate from start to finish: the fastest mate in chess.
rot.demos.louco.l1: White advances the f-pawn: the king's diagonal opens.
rot.demos.louco.l3: The second mistake: the g-pawn moves too.
rot.demos.louco.l4: The queen goes to h4: checkmate, right at the start of the game.
rot.demos.umErro.e1: Now White made only one mistake: the g-pawn is still at home.
rot.demos.umErro.l1: The queen checks on h4, as before.
rot.demos.umErro.l2: But the g-pawn blocks the check. It is not mate.
rot.demos.umErro.l3: And the pawn on g3 attacks the black queen. Without the second mistake, the trick does not work.
rot.demos.umErro.l4: Now it's your turn: use the fool's mate.
rot.pratica.pretas.enunciado: Open the queen's path. After White's second mistake, give mate along the diagonal.
rot.pratica.pretas.fim: Well done. Open diagonal and queen on h4: the fool's mate is done.
rot.pratica.brancas.enunciado: Now as White: Black moved f and g, and the diagonal from h5 to e8 is open. Give mate.
rot.pratica.brancas.fim: Perfect. Do not move the f- and g-pawns without reason: they shield the king.
